title: Charge a fault once to a complete queue-word edit invariant
statement: The actual acquired workingFIFOproof gives a literal queue interpretation for every finite controller tag state. Nominal moves preserve the word while each local fault causes a bounded number of stream edits, charged for all later event orders. All-state drain and transfer deadline-OR-edit contracts do not rely on independence of a future-selected initial state.
